artifact_trust_policy.trust_root: GitHub HTTPS, repository release permissions, and maintainer tag/Release discipline

runtime_contract.authoritative_roster: existing Feishu People Base; read the complete unfiltered table before every tick
runtime_contract.roster_failure_policy: fail closed: do not scan stale SQLite or publish reports
runtime_contract.schema_policy: discover live field metadata; add only missing machine-owned fields; never rename, delete, or overwrite human-owned fields
runtime_contract.review_policy: every potentially public change requires the current host Agent's bound publish/suppress/defer decision
runtime_contract.report_policy: public output contains concrete material people changes only; diagnostics go to the separate developer document
runtime_contract.scholar_policy: fixed weekly phase plus per-run/day/week budgets, persistent 429 circuit, and half-open canary
